texto_fuente: World English Bible, Catholic Edition (public domain), original text
frase_clave: My house is a house of prayer
reflexion: The Lord invites you to guard your heart as a sacred place of encounter and peace. Will you take a moment of silence today to talk with God and listen to Him?

escenas.descripcion: Inside the stone colonnades of the Temple, Jesus stands with dignified authority, driving out the merchants with a commanding gesture of purity and reverence.
Jesus sits gently under the arches of the Temple court, gesturing with warmth as He teaches the gathered listeners with a serene expression.
Chief priests and scribes whisper in shadowed irritation, unable to approach Jesus because an attentive crowd listens to Him with utter devotion.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, he entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it, saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!” He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him. They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

frase_es: Mi casa es casa de oración
reflexion_es: El Señor te invita a cuidar tu corazón como un lugar sagrado de encuentro y paz. ¿Dedicas hoy un momento de silencio para hablar con Dios y escucharle?
